Compare a first-time viewer's understanding of a promo clip with the truth.
TRUTH (from the show bible, for episodes E2): Premise: [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her.
Mayor Brisk (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 53 lines between E1 and E14
Widow Halloran (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 45 lines between E1 and E14
Tobin The Ferryman (a man in period dress): [mock] speaks 40 lines between E1 and E14
Corin (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 37 lines between E1 and E14
Arc [mock] Part 1: Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her.
E2: The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain.
CLIP: [On screen: Over-the-shoulder shot from the figure in period dress toward the figure in period dress.]
[Action: the figure in period dress grabs the figure in period dress by the wrist.]
a figure in period dress: "Expose me and her father hangs beside me."
[On screen: High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.]
a figure in period dress: "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
[On screen: Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.]
a man in period dress (off-screen): "They are coming up the cliff path with lanterns!"
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's jaw tightening.]
a figure in period dress: "The council has already decided her fate."
[On screen: Slow push-in on the widow as the lamp flickers behind them.]
[Action: the widow kneels on the slick quay boards.]
a figure in period dress: "Step away from her."
[On screen: Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.]
[Action: the figure in period dress tears the lace veil and lets it fall.]
a figure in period dress: "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
